newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Sun Hung Kai rates Fil-Estate a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sun Hung Kai rates Fil-Estate a buy.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phils) Inc recommended on Monday a buy on Fil-Estate Land Inc saying the company was poised for better projects and higher earnings in the next two years.

In a research paper, Sun Hung Kai said Fil-Estate's huge 30,000 sales force serves as pulse-takers of customer preferences and changing market trends allowing the company to design its projects to suit market preferences.
"Not only is Fil-Estate attuned to the market, it also has the capability to deliver the preferences of this market," said the brokerage house.
Fil-Estate is expected to post net profits of 1.81 billion pesos by year-end, 2.448 billion pesos in 1997 and 2.873 billion pesos in 1998.

Sun Hung Kai said Fil-Estate is practically debt-free as its marketing force can pre-sell projects, providing the company with substantial cash flow. Joint venture activities also limit the company's cash requirements to undertake land-banking, it said. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
